_note: Hand-checked impurity boxes [x1, y1, x2, y2] in pixels at 2016 px width (half of the 4032 px photos). Used by ml_service/prelabel.py --impurities.

_uncertain._note: Spots that MIGHT be impurities (tiny specks, glassy grey particle). Not labelled; augment_dataset.py keeps them out of pure-salt crops.

_no_paste._note: Real impurities whose cut-out mask is poor (holes / blurry / truncated). Still labelled; augment_dataset.py just won't copy-paste them.
